digest.component_or_area: metrics blame and bug close caused_by derivation
propositions: _blame_file_commits currently returns [] for both git failure and successful-but-empty blame, making the two cases indistinguishable and preventing failure detection
derive_caused_by can tally caused_by votes over a partial path set when some blame calls fail, electing a wrong culprit that would not win over the full set
Under a blobless promisor, git blame faults in blobs one at a time during derive_caused_by on every bug close without explicit --caused-by, risking partial failure
Cloning with --filter=blob:none (68.7 MiB / 14.3 s) is the accepted degradation versus full clone (1.04 GiB / 59 s), and --filter=tree:0 must never be used (3.57 GiB, 3.4x larger)
Documentation must record measured clone numbers, state the blob-filter degradation, and note that rebar cannot filter a clone it does not perform
